sonnet.problem: The question restates the right answer of card 15 (they untie their animals on the Sabbath) inside its setup, so an answer already shown is used again. It also carries a second claim in the setup instead of testing one claim.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: The card says 'Right in the middle of His teaching, Jesus sees her.' Luke 13:10-12 gives no point in the teaching when He sees her, so this adds a time the text doesn't give. Card 5's question repeats it with 'during His teaching.'
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
